meta.description: Click the wooden fish or press the spacebar to tap it and rack up merit - a little ritual for restless moments.
desc: Click the wooden fish or press the spacebar to tap it and rack up merit - a little ritual for restless moments.
ui.101: This tool is for relaxation and entertainment only and is not affiliated with any religious group; if you are truly troubled, please reach out to family, friends or professionals in time.
ui.102: The wooden fish sound is synthesized by the browser in real time, no audio files needed; auto tapping strikes at random intervals. The counter is stored in your local browser and is for entertainment only.
ui.16: Are you sure you want to reset the accumulated merit? This cannot be undone.
